National Assembly
Bissau Convention
Complete Details
Proceedings
27 Chaitra 2052
Friday
Meeting
Number- 4
The National Assembly's meeting today commenced at 16:25 hrs under the chairmanship of the Honorable Speaker, Mr. Narayan Prasad Dahal.
Honorable Speaker: - Honorable members, the proceedings of today's National Assembly meeting will commence at (16:25 hrs). Honorable members, I would like to inform you that there will be no "Zero Hour" and "Special Time" in today's meeting.
Honorable members, I would like to provide time to the Honorable Prime Minister, Mr. Balendra Shah, to present before the House the copy of the address delivered by the Honorable President to a joint session of both houses of the Federal Parliament on the 27th of Chaitra, 2082, at 15:00 hrs, in accordance with Article 94 of the Constitution of Nepal.
Honorable members, now, I would like to present the following proposal of thanks to the Honorable President for addressing the joint session of both houses of the Federal Parliament.
(Proposal of Thanks)
"This National Assembly meeting expresses its gratitude to the Honorable President for the address delivered to a joint session of both houses of the Federal Parliament on the 27th of Chaitra, 2082, at 15:00 hrs, in accordance with Article 95 of the Constitution of Nepal."
Honorable members, I request you to provide your consent to the above proposal.
Honorable members, I inform you that the proposal has been agreed upon by the House.
Honorable members, a letter regarding the reshuffling of the Council of Ministers has been received from the Office of the President. I will now provide the details of the said letter.
In accordance with Article 76, Sub-section (9) of the Constitution of Nepal, the Honorable President, Ram Chandra Paudel, has made the following division of responsibilities and reshuffle in the current Council of Ministers formed on the 13th of Chaitra, 2082, at the recommendation of the Honorable Prime Minister, Balendra Shah. The details are respectfully submitted.

Honorable members, in accordance with Rule 25, Sub-rule (2) of the Rules of Procedure of the Federal Parliament's Joint Session and Joint Committees, 2080:
1. Honorable Member Anand Prasad Dungana,
2. Honorable Member Nar Bahadur Bist, and
3. Honorable Member Prem Prasad Dangal
have been nominated to the Parliamentary Hearing Committee. And in accordance with Rule 28, Sub-rule (2) of the same Rules of Procedure, to the Committee for Monitoring and Evaluation of the Implementation of State Directive Principles, Policies, and Responsibilities:
1. Honorable Member Kiran Babu Shrestha,
2. Honorable Member Madan Kumari Shah (Garima), and
3. Honorable Member Dr. Anjan Shakya
have been nominated.
Honorable members, I request the House to provide its consent to the nomination of Honorable members for the Joint Committees of the Federal Parliament.
Honorable members, I inform you that the nomination of Honorable members for the Joint Committees of the Federal Parliament, namely the Parliamentary Hearing Committee and the Committee for Monitoring and Evaluation of the Implementation of State Directive Principles, Policies, and Responsibilities, has been agreed upon by the House.
Honorable members, the first meeting of the 20th session of the National Assembly of the Federal Parliament commenced on Thursday, Chaitra 19, 2082, at 2:00 PM and continued for a total of 9 days until Friday, Chaitra 27, 2082. During this period, 5 meetings were held, and a total of 4 hours and 45 minutes were spent on the business of the House. Today, the Honorable President also addressed the joint session of both houses.
During this session, there were 3 instances of Zero Hour. During that time, 26 Honorable members utilized 26 minutes, and there was one instance of Special Time. During Special Time, 12 Honorable members utilized 1 hour and 27 minutes. During this period, the House welcomed newly elected one-third of the Honorable members. Furthermore, during the session, the vacant post of the Deputy Speaker of the House was filled, and Honorable Member Lila Kumari Bhandari was unanimously selected as the Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly. The newly elected Honorable members presented their experiences along with their expected roles in the coming days. In this regard, 17 Honorable members utilized 1 hour and 25 minutes.
Honorable members, during the current session, Honorable members have been nominated to preside over meetings in the absence of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker. The House has made reshuffles and nominations of Honorable members to the Joint Committees of the Federal Parliament and the thematic committees under the House. Furthermore, the elections of the chairpersons of all four thematic committees have been unanimously completed. During the current session, in accordance with constitutional provisions, the annual reports of the National Women's Commission for FY 2081/082, the Adivasi Janajati Commission for FY 2081/082, and the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority for FY 2081/082 have been presented to the House. During this session, the House passed a condolence motion on the demise of former member of the National Assembly, Ramchandra Bhattarai.
Honorable members, the Federal Parliament Secretariat is preparing an orientation program for newly elected members with the objective of providing information on parliamentary practice, legislative process, the role of committees, and parliamentary etiquette. The Speaker is scheduled to depart on April 1st to participate in the 152nd Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) General Assembly in Istanbul, Turkey, from April 2nd to 6th, 2083. Formal information regarding the orientation program will be provided to the Honorable members after returning from the IPU.
Finally, I express my special thanks and gratitude to the Honorable President, the Honorable Prime Minister, Honorable Ministers, Members of the National Assembly, political parties, the Secretary-General of the Federal Parliament, the Secretary of the House, the Secretariat Secretary, the Management Division, all staff, security personnel, journalists, and security personnel for their significant role in successfully completing the 20th session.
Honorable members, a letter from the Honorable President regarding the conclusion of the current 20th session has been received. I will now provide the details of the said letter.
Honorable Speaker,
National Assembly,
Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.
In accordance with Article 93, Sub-section (2) of the Constitution of Nepal, upon the recommendation of the Council of Ministers of the Government of Nepal dated Chaitra 24, 2082, I hereby prorogue the current session of both houses of the Federal Parliament, effective from 12:00 AM on Friday, Chaitra 27, 2082.
(Ram Chandra Paudel)
President
Chaitra 26, 2082
Honorable members, I declare this meeting adjourned, with the current 20th session of the National Assembly automatically concluding from 12:00 AM tonight.
Adjourned: 16:35 hrs.
